BLS Polymers IPO is a book build issue of ₹255.00 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 1.70 crore shares of ₹255.00 crore.

BLS Polymers IPO bidding started from Oct 27, 2026 and ended on Oct 29, 2026. The allotment for BLS Polymers IPO was finalized on Oct 30, 2026. The shares got listed on NSE and BSE on Nov 3, 2026.

BLS Polymers IPO is set final issue price at ₹150 per share. The lot size for an application is 100 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹15,000 (100 shares) (based on upper price).

Unistone Capital Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Kfin Technologies Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

Refer to BLS Polymers IPO RHP for detailed Information.

About BLS Polymers Ltd.

Updated on Nov 4, 2026
BLS Polymers Ltd. manufactures specialised polymer compounds used in wires, cables and underground pipelines. Its products include HDPE, MDPE, LLDPE, XLPE, PVC, HFFR, cable filling compounds and adhesive coating compounds, catering to industries such as power, telecommunications, railways, water, and oil and gas.

The company operates a manufacturing facility in Goa, spread across approximately 24,220 sq. metres and equipped with 11 machines. It has an in-house laboratory, a quality control team and ISO 9001:2015 certification. The company also develops customised products to meet specific customer requirements.

BLS Polymers serves more than 190 customers and exports its products to countries including Bangladesh, Egypt, Saudi Arabia, the UAE, the USA and Zambia.

Its proximity to Mormugao Port supports the import of raw materials and export of finished products.

Competitive Strengths

  • Government Approvals: Enlisted with prominent government agencies with a pre-approved product portfolio.
  • Diversified Product Portfolio: Caters to multiple industries with specialised polymer compounds.
  • Established Customer Relationships: More than 100 customers have been associated with the company for over three years.
  • Wide Market Presence: Serves customers across India and international markets.
  • Product Development Capabilities: Develops customised polymer compounds to meet specific industry and customer requirements.

IPO FAQs

BLS Polymers IPO is a main-board IPO of 1.70 Cr equity shares with a face value of ₹10 each aggregating up to ₹255.00 Crores. The issue is priced at ₹150 per share. The minimum order quantity is 100.

The IPO opens on Tue, Oct 27, 2026, and closes on Thu, Oct 29, 2026.

Kfin Technologies Ltd. is the registrar for the IPO. The shares are proposed to be listed on BSE, NSE.

Zerodha customers can apply for the BLS Polymers IPO online through the Kite platform under the IPO & Bids section using UPI as the payment method.

Steps to Apply for BLS Polymers IPO through Zerodha

  1. Log in to your Zerodha Kite account.
  2. On the home page, click IPO & Bids in the top menu.
  3. Select the IPO tab and find the BLS Polymers IPO in the list.
  4. Click Apply next to the IPO.
  5. Enter your UPI ID, bid quantity, and bid price.
  6. Submit the IPO application.
  7. Open your UPI app and approve the mandate to complete the application process.

For more details, visit the Zerodha IPO Application Process Review.

The BLS Polymers IPO opens on Tue, Oct 27, 2026 and closes on Thu, Oct 29, 2026.

BLS Polymers IPO lot size is 100, and the minimum amount required for application is ₹15,000.

You can apply in BLS Polymers IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha, Upstox, 5Paisa, Nuvama, HDFC Bank, and SBI Bank.

The finalization of Basis of Allotment for BLS Polymers IPO will be done on Friday, October 30, 2026, and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Mon, Nov 2, 2026. Check the BLS Polymers IPO allotment status.

The listing date of BLS Polymers IPO is Tue, Nov 3, 2026.
